data.title: 卡莲 · 盛夏泳池白泳装的休日午后
data.description: 【卡莲 · 盛夏泳池白泳装的休日午后】盛夏休日的教会学校泳池，蝉鸣与水声交织。卡莲罕见地换下了庄重的祭服，穿着圣洁纯白的高开叉竞速泳装坐在池边，把白皙的脚尖轻轻浸在波光里。侧腰的开衩勾勒出她纤细又匀称的身段，银白短发用发夹别在耳后。她单手撑着池畔回眸，琥珀色的眼眸里带着一丝促狭的笑意——「难得的休日哦。要不要陪我一起泡水？放心，今天的布道……改成了水中的告白。」
data.location: 盛夏骄阳下的教会学校泳池池畔
data.action: 坐在池畔单手撑地回眸，脚尖点水漾起涟漪，泳装侧衩勾勒身段促狭浅笑
data.lighting: 高照度夏日阳光在池面折射的粼粼光斑
data.camera: cowboy shot, eye level, supporting palm and feet in water visible
data.mood: 清冷中带着休日的松弛
data.promptProse: Seated along the tiled pool edge on a summer afternoon, Caren Hortensia supports herself with one palm behind her and rests the other hand beside her knee. Preserve the opaque white high-neck one-piece competition swimsuit with its cross-back straps. Both feet dip into the water, sending small ripples away from the wall as she turns back with a restrained smile and amber-yellow eyes. The eye-level cowboy view includes the near tile lip and the pool stretching toward a distant lane rope and shaded benches. Sunlight touches her clipped silver hair and the upper edge of the white suit. Reflected water patterns move across the tiles beneath her hand, with a short palm contact shadow and a darker band below the pool coping grounding the seated pose.
